Tomá las ruinas de Flers y sostenelas un: Take the ruins of Flers and hold them for a minute. That day a Mark I drove down the main street of Flers with the infantry behind it: it was the news of the day in London.
Llegá con tu Schneider hasta Juvincourt,: Reach Juvincourt, the third German line, with your Schneider. That day almost no tank made it: the artillery saw them coming from the heights.
Destruí todas las baterías alemanas de l: Destroy every German battery on Flesquières ridge. In 1917 those guns stopped dozens of Mark IVs: find them before they find you.
Destruí a los A7V. Es el primer duelo de: Destroy the A7Vs. It's the first tank duel in history: Lieutenant Mitchell's male Mark IV against "Nixe" and its companions.
Villers-Bretonneux ya es tuyo: sostené e: Villers-Bretonneux is yours: hold the town for 8 minutes against the counterattack of the Mark IVs and Whippets. If you lose it, the mission fails.
Acompañá a la infantería hasta Essey: ti: Escort the infantry to Essey: at least 5 soldiers must arrive alive. The FTs went ahead clearing the way through the wire and the machine guns.
Hacé lo que hizo Arman: entrá a Seseña,: Do what Arman did: get into Seseña, destroy 3 enemies and return to your base with your tank intact. With no infantry to cover you, don't linger.
Tomá el cerro del Pingarrón y sostenelo: Take Pingarrón hill and hold it for a minute and a half. Whoever holds the hill sees the whole Valencia road.
El Pingarrón es tuyo: sostenelo 9 minuto: Pingarrón is yours: hold it for 9 minutes against the T-26s and BT-5s. If the Republicans retake it, the mission fails.
Destruí los cañones antitanque de la azu: Destroy the anti-tank guns at the sugar mill and in the town. In 1937 the attack failed against them: cross the ditches at the crossings and don't get stuck.
Lo tomaron y lo sostuvieron: They took it and held it
Regresá a tu base con el tanque entero: Return to your base with your tank intact
Volviste con el tanque entero: You came back with your tank intact

Pasto que se mueve con el viento alreded: Wind-swept grass around the camera and leafy tree crowns. "High" is heavier on the graphics card. Applies from the next battle.
